t.zh: 已知晨星 = 昏星，按定义写出来。<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>换掉 P 的是一句说 x 的话，每个 P(t) 都换成这句话，x 处填 t。
t.en: Given the Morning Star = the Evening Star, written out by the definition. <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> puts in a sentence about x for P: each P(t) becomes that sentence with t in place of x.

after.zh: 这就是<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>：定义直接写下了相等的消去规则。
after.en: This is <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>: the definition writes down equality’s elimination rule directly.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>里选的是一种性质：「B(x)」，把 P 换掉。
hint.en: In <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> choose a property: “B(x)”, to put in for P.

hint.zh: 得到「B(晨星) → B(昏星)」，再套用。
hint.en: That gives “B(the Morning Star) → B(the Evening Star)”; then Apply.
